# The person who can say no

Mum agrees to appointments offered over the phone and later asks me whether she can change them. The tone of the invitation makes a time sound compulsory. Put two acceptable alternatives on the card beside the phone. [[Care arrangements]]: support should expand her choices rather than make me the person whose permission is needed to refuse something.
